segments.text:
V. 13.
For no one—For here you muſt rely on my ſingle Teſtimony, whereas there you have a Cloud of Witneſſes: Hath gone up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven. Who is in Leaven— Therefore He is Omnipreſent; elſe He could not be in Heaven and on Earth at once. This is a plain Inſtance of what is uſually termed the Communication of Properties between the Divine and Human Nature; whereby what is proper to the Divine Nature is ſpoken concerning the Human, and what is proper to the Human is, as here, ſpoken of the Divine.
